title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold9 to bring back a long-lost feature the iPhone Duo has
description: Samsung put an under-display camera on the inner screen of its book-style foldables for four generations, starting with the Galaxy Z Fold3 back in 2021 and ending with the Galaxy Z Fold6. The Galaxy Z Fold7 switched to a regular punch hole last year, and this year's Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra and wide Galaxy Z Fold8 stuck with it. Now, the under-display camera will reportedly make a comeback next year. According to a tipster on X, Samsung will unveil a device with an under-display camera, "major internal changes", and minimal changes to its overall thickness and design. Earlier this month, the...

title: WhatsApp announces new features, including Group Status
description: WhatsApp has announced new features. First is Group Status, which, as the name suggests, lets you share Status updates visible only to group members, who can view, react to, and like the statuses, and add their own. Group Statuses, like regular statuses, disappear after 24 hours. WhatsApp already lets group admins share a group's message history with new members when they are being added to the group. Now, you can also share old messages with new members after they join the group. Just tap their name in the group chat. Speaking of messages, WhatsApp now lets you pin messages in a...

title: Deals: iPhone 17 series on sale, OLED-packing iPad mini and touch-enabled MacBook Pro launch
description: Apple launched the iPhone Duo last week and unlike most of its releases, it hasn’t been smooth sailing. So, let’s look at the non-folding iPhones instead, plus the two new releases from this week – the theme this week was “OLED”. We’ll start with a nice middle ground – the Apple iPhone 17. The vanilla 18 isn’t coming out for a few more months, so this is the current offering. We rarely see discounts on Apple products, but this vanilla model is €180 off for the base 256GB variant. The upgrade to 512GB storage is crazy expensive, though. ...

title: Samsung Galaxy Fit4 leaks, key features revealed
description: Last week we got our first look at the upcoming Samsung Galaxy Fit4 and we now have some specs to go with the images. Thanks to an APK teardown of the Galaxy Fit4 Manager companion app shared by SammyGuru we now have most of the wearable’s key specs. Galaxy Fit4 UI (source: SammyGuru) For the most part, it appears to be very similar to 2024’s Galaxy Fit3 with similar-looking dimensions. title: Here's when Samsung plans to release its Android XR glasses and where
description: Earlier this month, a report out of South Korea claimed that Samsung's Intelligent Eyewear would launch in November, citing "a Samsung official". Today, a new report from the same country tells us when you'll actually be able to buy the glasses: in mid-December. That's not the whole story, though, as they're said to only go on sale in South Korea and the US at first, with Europe, China, and Japan left out of the initial release. Apparently, Samsung wants to see how the Korean and US markets react before expanding to more regions, which is pretty much what it did with its Galaxy XR headset....

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro vs. iPhone 18 Pro Max
description: It's time for an upgrade, and you are eyeing the new iPhone 18 Pro series. But which one to get? The smaller iPhone 18 Pro or the larger iPhone 18 Pro Max? Sometimes it's not just about screen size; it's also about features and performance. The Pro Max has historically been better at endurance and has offered one or two exclusive features. So what else is the 18 Pro Max's price premium buying you except a larger screen size? Let's dive in and find out. title: The Galaxy S27 Ultra chipset saga continues, here's the latest twist
description: Which chipset the Galaxy S27 Ultra will use has turned into quite the saga over the past few months. Back in July, the Ultra was said to be getting a Snapdragon chip globally, while the rest of the lineup would use the Exynos 2700 outside of North America. Then in early September, insiders claimed that Samsung was building Exynos 2700-powered S27 Ultras for Korea and Europe. In early October, Samsung reportedly started mass producing the Exynos 2700, with the decision for the Ultra still up in the air, and a few days later a new insider tip claimed that the S27 Ultra would only be...

title: A new vulnerability can brick your Android phone when receiving the SMS of Death
description: Security researcher Mark Blaszczyk found a new scary vulnerability that affects phones running Android 12 or later. It involves receiving a specially crafted WAP Push SMS message that Android's telephony framework cannot properly process. The tricky part is that instead of displaying the message in the inbox, Android tries to process it in the background. This triggers an error that can cause all sorts of issues. Active phone calls start to disconnect, the device temporarily loses cellular service, and when receiving multiple messages like this, the device can even become unusable....

title: Oppo Find X10 review
Samsung announces another record-breaking quarter, driven by its memory business
description: Samsung Electronics just announced another all-time high quarterly result – revenue grew by 14% quarter-on-quarter (compared to Q3). The press release claims that Samsung Electronics is the world’s first tech company to exceed KRW 100 trillion in quarterly operating profit – specifically, it took in KRW 107.4 trillion in operating profit. Device Solutions (DS), the division that makes memory chips, is at the heart of all this growth. It posted KRW 147.1 trillion in consolidated revenue and a whopping KRW 106.5 trillion in operating profit – another record-breaking quarter for the DS...

title: Oppo Reno17 series confirmed to launch next month, blind pre-orders go live
description: Oppo’s upcoming Reno17 series has been the subject of several leaks and rumors over the past few weeks. While a recent rumor pointed to a launch next month, Oppo has now officially confirmed the timeline. In a post on Weibo, Oppo's official account confirmed that the Reno17 series will launch in China next month, although the company has yet to announce an exact date. Interested buyers can already visit Oppo's online store to pre-reserve the upcoming smartphones. Alongside the Reno17 series, Oppo will also introduce its new Watch 5 smartwatch and Pad Air 6 tablet. Both devices are...

title: The new iPad mini's battery capacity is no longer a mystery
description: Apple unveiled the iPad mini (2026) on Monday with an OLED screen and the A20 Pro chipset, and while it told us the battery is rated at 18.9Wh, it didn't give its capacity in mAh, in typical Apple fashion. Today, that's finally been revealed thanks to the tablet's listing in the EU's EPREL database. According to the listing for model number A3596, the new iPad mini has a rated battery capacity of 4,900 mAh. That's a bit smaller than the 5,078 mAh (19.3Wh) cell in the iPad mini (2024), which isn't exactly surprising given that the new model is almost 1mm thinner and close to 40g...

title: Samsung is reportedly working on a huge foldable tablet
description: Back in late August, a tipster on X claimed that a 17-inch foldable tablet is in development, with multiple versions and test devices being worked on, but didn't say which company is making it. Now, the same tipster has followed up with a short but telling addition, revealing that "Samsung has already started." According to the original post, the device becomes an 8-inch tablet when folded and expands to 17 inches when unfolded. That's all we've got for now, as the tipster says they can't share any more details yet. How exactly the 8-inch folded state would work is anyone's guess at...

title: Oppo Reno17 F 5G gets NBTC certified
description: Oppo has confirmed it will unveil the Reno17 series in China next month, but it hasn't officially said when it will launch internationally. While we await more information on the Reno17 series' global debut, Thailand's NBTC has certified the Reno17 F 5G, bringing it a step closer to launch. The NBTC listing for the Reno17 F 5G includes its model code, CPH3013, but it doesn't reveal anything else. However, the Reno17 F 5G has already received certifications from other authorities, including India's BIS and Indonesia's TKDN, suggesting its international debut isn't far off. The...

title: Strava subscribers can now connect directly to Google Gemini for personalized workout insights
description: Back in June, Strava launched the Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector, letting subscribers query their Strava data through Claude for in-depth training insights. Building on that launch, Strava has announced a Google Gemini integration that lets subscribers get more from their training. Strava subscribers who connect directly to Google Gemini will now get more contextual and personalized answers based on their activity history. Once connected, Gemini can analyze Strava users' data and tell them whether they are getting faster at the same heart rate, how strength training is affecting...

title: Omdia: global smartphone shipments declined 20 percent YoY in Q3 2026
description: According to a new report by research firm Omdia, global smartphone shipments declined 20 percent year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026. Manufacturers shipped a total of 254.7 million units during the quarter. The report noted that this was the lowest third-quarter shipment volume since 2013, attributing the decline to rising smartphone prices. Samsung retained its position as the world's largest smartphone maker, shipping 57.8 million units, however, it was down 5 percent year-on-year. Apple followed closely with 56.5 million iPhones shipped, keeping its shipment numbers...

title: Gemini now lets you edit the files it creates right in the chat
description: Back in April, Google's Gemini gained the ability to generate files for you, from Docs and Sheets to PDFs and Markdown. Until now, though, if you wanted to tweak what it came up with, you had to download or export the file first. Today, Google is fixing that by letting you preview and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, code, and more right in the Gemini app. Files can be expanded to full screen, where you can type your edits directly, highlight text to ask questions about it, have Gemini refine the text or visuals, or ask it follow-up questions. title: vivo S70's full camera details emerge in new leak
description: Last week, a rumour claimed that vivo was preparing to launch the S70 in China with a 64MP Sony periscope telephoto camera and support for a teleconverter. Now, a new leak has revealed the handset's complete camera specifications. According to tipster Digital Chat Station, the vivo S70 will feature a 50MP primary rear sensor and an 8MP ultrawide camera alongside the 64MP periscope telephoto unit. vivo S60 also offers a triple-rear camera setup. title: The Nokia 2360 Flip is a dual-display feature phone with an SOS button
description: HMD has unveiled the Nokia 2360 Flip, its latest feature phone with a clamshell design and the Family Assist feature. Designed with school students and senior citizens in mind, the phone features dual displays and a dedicated SOS button. The Nokia 2360 Flip's main highlight is its Family Assist feature, which allows family members to remotely manage the device. They can add contacts, adjust volume levels, set reminders, and access other settings remotely. It also features a dedicated SOS button on the rear panel. Pressing it calls a pre-set emergency contact and sends an alert...

title: The new OLED iPad mini runs Geekbench, here are the results
description: Apple unveiled the iPad mini (2026) with an OLED screen and the A20 Pro chipset on Monday, and the first units will reach buyers on November 6. Ahead of that, one has already been run through Geekbench 7, so we now have a good idea of how it performs. The listing is for the iPad19,2, which is the Wi-Fi + Cellular model, and it shows 3,879 points in the single-core test and 9,870 in multi-core. The CPU has five cores (two performance and three efficiency ones), with the performance cores clocked at 4.93GHz.
